# Fixture upstream

A pocket-size `angular/angular` checkout for the tooling tests: the files the tooling reads
(adev/src/content, navigation entries, app templates, index.html, adev/firebase.json, .nvmrc,
package.json) with representative content. `adev/shared-docs/pipeline/shared/heading.mts` is
upstream's own file (MIT, Google LLC), used by the heading-anchor parity test when origin/ is absent.
